Is America's AI empire compromised? Nvidia, the world's leading AI chipmaker, has launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman identified in reports as a suspected Chinese spy.
US intelligence officials reportedly suspect Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed International, was recruited by China's intelligence agency. Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer, purchased $2 billion worth of the company's products and is suspected by US officials of helping divert restricted AI chips to China.
